description: 第二个不同官方实链GET，取法定主动公开内容实际导航；预算内无猜路径或重试
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from urllib.parse import urljoin
import json,hashlib,re,requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
base=Path('reports/research/510300_industrial_original_archive_route_probe_v1')
prev=json.loads((base/'第一原公开入口实际读取.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
targets=[x for x in prev['all_actual_links'] if re.sub(r'\s+','',x['text'])=='法定主动公开内容']
urls=sorted(set(x['absolute_url'] for x in targets));assert len(urls)==1;url=urls[0]
assert hashlib.sha256(Path(prev['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==prev['sha256']
ledger=base/'实际原公开导航GET账本.jsonl'
events=[json.loads(x) for x in ledger.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()]
assert len([x for x in events if x['event']=='REQUEST_STARTED'])==1
assert url not in [x['url'] for x in events if x['event']=='REQUEST_STARTED']
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
def trace(x):
 with ledger.open('a',encoding='utf-8') as f:f.write(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n');f.flush()
out={'requested_url':url,'started_at':now(),'actual_original_GET_index':2,'actual_prior_hrefs':targets,'raw_GET_retries':0}
trace({'at':now(),'event':'REQUEST_STARTED','url':url,'attempt':1})
try:
 r=requests.get(url,timeout=(10,30));p=base/'sources'/'actual_statutory_open_content_root.html';p.write_bytes(r.content)
 s=BeautifulSoup(r.content.decode('utf-8-sig',errors='replace'),'html.parser');full=s.get_text('\n',strip=True)
 out.update(status_code=r.status_code,final_url=r.url,path=p.as_posix(),sha256=hashlib.sha256(r.content).hexdigest(),bytes=len(r.content),status='BROWSER_CHECK_ONLY' if 'Please enable JavaScript and refresh the page.' in full else ('ORIGINAL_PAGE' if r.status_code==200 else 'HTTP_FAILED'),full_text=full)
 out['all_actual_links']=[{'text':a.get_text(' ',strip=True),'raw_href':a['href'],'absolute_url':urljoin(r.url,a['href'])} for a in s.select('a[href]')]
 out['all_actual_iframes']=[{'src':a['src'],'absolute_url':urljoin(r.url,a['src'])} for a in s.select('iframe[src]')]
 out['scripts']=[{'src':a.get('src'),'body':a.get_text()[:25000]} for a in s.select('script') if a.get('src') or any(x in a.get_text() for x in ['xxgk','location','href','sjfb','Tree'])]
except Exception as e:out.update(status='GET_FAILED_NO_RETRY',error_type=type(e).__name__,error=str(e))
out['completed_at']=now();trace({'event':'REQUEST_FINISHED',**{k:v for k,v in out.items() if k not in ['all_actual_links','scripts','full_text']}})
p=base/'第二原法定公开入口实际读取.json';assert not p.exists();p.write_text(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in out.items() if k not in ['all_actual_links','scripts','full_text']},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
print('实际相关原锚',json.dumps([a for a in out.get('all_actual_links',[]) if any(x in a['text'] for x in ['数据','统计','发布','历史']) or 'sjfb' in a['absolute_url']],ensure_ascii=False)[:6500],flush=True)
print('相关原脚本',json.dumps(out.get('scripts',[]),ensure_ascii=False)[:2800],flush=True)
